Method of Attack: Abusing undocumented internal API actions to modify or delete public container images, layers, tags, registries, and repositories of other users
Forging malicious API requests authenticated via temporary credentials from Amazon Cognito
Injecting malicious code into container images
Impacted Systems: Amazon ECR (Elastic Container Registry) Public Gallery
Container images including Nginx, EKS Distro, Amazon Linux, CloudWatch agent, Datadog agent
Kubernetes clusters pulling images from ECR Public Gallery
Attack Vector: Undocumented internal API actions in Amazon ECR Public Gallery
Authentication via temporary credentials from Amazon Cognito
